scene: The dumbwaiter shoots you up onto the breezy hotel rooftop transport deck.
picture: A flat side view along the tiled hotel rooftop. At the left hangs an open bamboo cable car. The player stands centre-left in her red bomber jacket and roller skates. Up high centre, a giant glowing paper-lantern balloon floats tethered. At the right sits a round purple bowling-ball monorail car on rails.
shown: a green bamboo cable car dangling open on thick ropes at the left
a huge glowing paper-lantern hot air balloon tethered up high centre
a glossy spherical purple monorail capsule waiting on rails at the right
